The primary material of a candle is typically wax, which serves as the fuel source. Common types of wax include paraffin, beeswax, soy wax, and palm wax. The wax is usually combined with a wick, often made of cotton or paper, which draws the liquid wax up via capillary action to be vaporized and burned.
